git.notes: Tracking fork of makeplane/plane-mcp-server. Run ./scripts/sync-upstream.sh before branching. PRs go to itqanlab/plane-mcp-server only, never upstream (push to upstream is disabled on purpose). One self-contained fix per commit so it can be upstreamed later (FORK.md).

quality.pre_push: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q && .venv/bin/ruff check plane_mcp/ tests/ && .venv/bin/ruff format --check plane_mcp/

ci.notes: The repo's workflows (build-branch.yml, publish-pypi.yml) are manual/release only; nothing runs on a PR. The local quality gate is the gate.

deploy.notes: The MCP runs from this repo's .venv (~/.claude.json mcpServers.plane -> /Volumes/SanDiskSSD/mine/plane-mcp-server/.venv/bin/plane-mcp-server stdio). A merged change takes effect after the plane MCP reconnects (/mcp -> plane -> reconnect, or a new Claude Code session). Verify live by calling the changed tool through mcp__plane__* after the reconnect.

verify.how: Unit tests with the SpyClient (tests/tools/) plus one live call of the changed action through the reconnected plane MCP against https://tasks.itqanlab.com (workspace itqan). Use the PMCP project itself as the test board; never write to client projects (HLMNA, DETALIA, ...) to test.
